title: Urgent lane request
description: Designed (docs/native/capture-split.md 4.3 "The route", 7.5, #773), not implemented. The body of `POST /api/station/urgent`: capture's own sender hands the hub the urgent items that cannot wait for the app. `Content-Type: application/json`, plain JSON with a `Content-Length`, at most 65536 bytes and 32 items. Opened by an `sz1` token with the `radio-receive` role (a station's own token stands for the role until roles exist); never by `sw1`, and not by the hub's older shared station token (a station still on it runs in `urgent-mode write`). The sender never puts an alarm and a page in one request (two connections: alarms in row order, for a page only the highest unsent rev of each key); a hub takes a request that holds both. An item is (station, key, rev), the station from the token, and the route is idempotent by all three. A post here does not count as the station being seen.

station.description: The station id the hub assigned (the wish's `hub.station`). Checked against the token: another id is refused (`id_mismatch`).

urgent_epoch.description: The urgent file's epoch, 16 hex characters. Informative, not a cursor.

sent_at.description: The station's wall clock when this request was made, Unix seconds. For the hub's skew measure only, never to place an item.
